mapper.sql: id, event_id, event_type, routing_key, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, published_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_outbox (event_id, event_type, routing_key, payload, status, attempts, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{outbox.eventId}, #{outbox.eventType}, #{outbox.routingKey}, #{outbox.payload}, #{outbox.status}, #{outbox.attempts}, #{outbox.nextAttemptAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM message_outbox WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
